overloads.semanticRole: SET TABLE TITLES lets you mask, rename, and reorder the tables of your database that appear in standard 4D dialog boxes within the Application environment (i.e.

jointConstraints.rule: tableTitles and tableNumbers must be passed together or not at all: they are parallel/synchronized arrays (same length; tableNumbers[i] is the actual table number for the display name tableTitles[i]), and a table omitted from tableTitles is hidden from the standard dialogs.

constraints: Calling SET TABLE TITLES with no parameters at all resets the whole virtual structure (custom table and field names) for the session.

Scope is the current worksession; it does not change the actual database structure, only subsequent standard-editor/dynamic-name display in the Application environment, and it does not override a table's Invisible property.

By default, formulas cannot use the custom names defined here (the real table names must be used); passing the trailing '*' lets formulas/expressions (e.g. formula editor, 4D Write Pro documents) use the custom names instead — but those custom names must not contain characters forbidden by the 4D language interpreter (e.g. -?*%!).
